positions.title: Tech Lead
positions.locationName: Amherst, New Hampshire, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Led a team of engineers responsible for updating the company’s legacy flagship nursing cloud
platform. Rapid ramp up on the business domain to be able to lead technical and design meetings.
Planned and documented application and data architecture for both front and back end(including
UI/UX). Established best practices in devops including deployment infrastructure, branching
strategies, and workflow processes. Worked with business to establish AGILE practices.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Built out environments for development
- Setup and configured continuous integration for projects
- Gathered requirements for projects 
- Architected and developed projects based on requirements
- Wrote documentation for applications
- Established weekly development training/knowledge-sharing sessions
- Wrote SQL queries and stored procedures for reports and dev implementations
